passive.name: Invincible Rider
passive.text: The Shield value provided by the equipper increases by **30/38/46/52/60%**. When any squad member triggers **Interrupt** or **Perfect Dodge**, all squad members' DMG increases by **18/22.5/27/31.5/36%** and Daze dealt increases by **12/15/18/21/24%** for 20s. Passive effects of the same name do not stack.

passive.name: Starlight Knight Flying Kick
passive.text: Increases Max HP by **8/9/10/11/12.5%**. When attacked, the equipper's Impact is increased by **10/11.5/13/14.5/16%** for 12s.

passive.name: Hot Spring Soup
passive.text: Reduces DMG taken by **7.5/8.5/9.5/10.5/12%**. When attacked, the equipper's Energy Generation Rate increases by **10/11.5/13/14.5/16%** for 12s. When the equipper switches off-field, this buff will be transferred to the new on-field character with its duration refreshed. Passive effects of the same name do not stack.

passive.name: Standard Blocking Technique
passive.text: While Shielded, the equipper's Energy Regen increases by **0.4/0.46/0.52/0.58/0.64**/s. The Anomaly Buildup of **EX Special Attacks**/**Assist Follow-Ups** increase by **36/40/45/50/55%**.

substatLine: CRIT RATE = CRIT DMG > ATK% > PEN = ATK
skillPriority: Assist > Special Attack > Basic Attack > Dodge > Chain Attack

entries.name: Basic Attack: Rampaging Slash
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack to activate:
Unleashes up to 6 slashes ahead, dealing **Physical DMG**.

entries.name: Basic Attack: Dead End
entries.text:
When there are sufficient **Assist Points**, hold Basic Attack to activate:
Consume 1 **Assist Point** to toss the shield and attack nearby enemies in all directions, dealing **Physical DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Dodge: Adrift
entries.text:
Press Dodge to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Dash Attack: Hog Rush
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack during a dodge to activate:
Strikes forward with the shield, dealing **Physical DMG**.
During skill activation, DMG taken is reduced by 40%, and when attacked by an enemy, Caesar blocks with the shield and gets knocked back. Following that, press Special Attack or EX Special Attack to trigger **Retaliation** and activate **Special Attack: Roaring Thrust** or **EX Special Attack: Overpowered Shield Bash**.

entries.name: Dodge Counter: Eye For an Eye
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack during a **Perfect Dodge** to activate:
Stabs at enemies in front, dealing **Physical DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Quick Assist: Lane Change
entries.text:
When the active character is launched, press Switch to activate:
Thrust at enemies in front, dealing **Physical DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Defensive Assist: Aegis Shield
entries.text:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press Switch to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of **Assist Points** when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Assist Follow-Up: Aiding Blade
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack after a **Defensive Assist** to activate:
Tosses the shield forward, unleashing a powerful spinning attack on enemies in front, followed by a slash that deals **Physical DMG**.
After activating the skill, press Special Attack or EX Special Attack to trigger a **Retaliation**, activating **Special Attack: Roaring Thrust** or **EX Special Attack: Overpowered Shield Bash**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Special Attack: Shockwave Shield Bash
entries.text:
Press Special Attack to activate:
Strike forward with the shield, dealing **Physical DMG**.
If Caesar is hit by an enemy at the beginning of the skill's activation, it will trigger a **Perfect Block**, negating the damage once and automatically following up with a **Special Attack: Roaring Thrust**.
After using the skill, Caesar enters a guard stance, reducing incoming damage by 40%. When attacked by an enemy, Caesar blocks with the shield and gets slightly knocked back. Press Special Attack or EX Special Attack to trigger **Retaliation**, activating **Special Attack: Roaring Thrust** or **EX Special Attack: Overpowered Shield Bash**
When **Retaliation** is triggered, Caesar is invulnerable while using the skill.

entries.name: Special Attack: Roaring Thrust
entries.text:
After activating **Special Attack: Shockwave Shield Bash**, press Special Attack to activate:
Thrusts forward, dealing **Physical DMG**.
If **Perfect Block** or **Retaliation** is not triggered, the Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill when **Perfect Block** or **Retaliation** is triggered.

entries.name: EX Special Attack: Parry Counter
entries.text:
With enough Energy, press EX Special Attack to activate:
Strikes forward with the shield, followed by a powerful thrust, dealing massive **Physical DMG**.
If Caesar is hit by an enemy at the beginning of the skill activation or an **Interrupt** is triggered with the shield strike, it will trigger **Perfect Block**, negating incoming damage once and countering with a shield attack. After triggering **Perfect Block**, press EX Special Attack to activate **EX Special Attack: Overpowered Shield Bash** without consuming energy.
After using the skill, Caesar enters a guard stance, reducing incoming damage by 40%. When attacked by an enemy, Caesar blocks the attack and is knocked back. Press Special Attack or EX Special Attack to trigger **Retaliation** and activate **Special Attack: Roaring Thrust** or **EX Special Attack: Overpowered Shield Bash**
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: EX Special Attack: Overpowered Shield Bash
entries.text:
After activating **EX Special Attack: Parry Counter**, with enough energy, press EX Special Attack to activate:
Strikes forward with the shield, dealing massive **Physical DMG**.
If Caesar is hit by an enemy at the beginning of the skill activation or an **Interrupt** is triggered with the shield strike, it will trigger **Perfect Block**, negating incoming damage once and recovering the Energy used to activate the skill.
When the skill is activated through **Perfect Block** or **Retaliation**, it cannot trigger **Perfect Block** again.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Stance Switch
entries.text: When Caesar triggers a **Perfect Block**, **Retaliation**, or **Defensive Assist**, her impact is increased by **20**% for 3s.

entries.name: Chain Attack: Road Rage Slam
entries.text:
When a **Chain Attack** is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a powerful downward strike at enemies ahead, dealing massive **Physical DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Ultimate: Savage Smash
entries.text:
When Decibel Rating is at **Maximum**, press Ultimate to activate:
Tosses the shield forward, unleashing a powerful spinning attack on enemies in front, followed by a downward strike, dealing massive **Physical DMG**.
When hitting shielded enemies, the Daze dealt is increased by **100%**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Core Passive: Barrier of Resilience
entries.text:
When Caesar activates **EX Special Attack: Parry Counter**, **Chain Attack**, **Ultimate**, or triggers **EX Special Attack: Overpowered Shield Bash** through **Retaliation**, she buffs all squad members with a **Radiant Aegis** shield equal to **1,400%** of her base Impact + **1,400**. The shield lasts for 60s and is equipped by the active character, with its value shared among all squad members. Any single instance of DMG will not exceed the shield value.
While **Radiant Aegis** is active, the shield bearer's Anti-Interrupt level is increased.
While **Radiant Aegis** is active, the shield bearer's ATK is increased by **1,000**. After **Radiant Aegis** expires, this buff remains for an additional 5s.

entries.name: Additional Ability: Battle Spirit
entries.text:
When another character in your squad can activate **Defensive Assist** or shares the same Faction:
When Caesar activates **Perfect Block**, **Retaliation**, **Defensive Assist**, or **Basic Attack: Dead End**, she applies a Debuff effect to enemies within a 7m radius, increasing the damage they take from all squad members by 25% for 30s.

entries.name: Spearhead Advance
entries.text:
When Caesar becomes the active character in combat, she instantly buffs all squad members with a **Radiant Aegis** shield. This effect can trigger once every 300s.
While **Radiant Aegis** is active, enemies within a 5m radius of the shield bearer suffer a 15% All-Attribute RES reduction.

entries.name: Legacy of the Far Lands
entries.text: While **Radiant Aegis** from **Core Passive: Barrier of Resilience** is active, Caesar's Energy Generation Rate increases by 10%, and the shield bearer's ATK boost is increased to 150% of its original value.

entries.name: Absolute Trust
entries.text: **Basic Attack**, **Dodge**, **Assist**, **Special Attack**, and **Chain Attack** Lv. +2

entries.name: Aries the Battering-Ram
entries.text:
When Caesar uses a **Chain Attack** or **Ultimate**, she gains 3 additional **Assist Points**.
If her Energy is below 20, she can activate **EX Special Attack: Overpowered Shield Bash** with 1 **Assist Point** instead. This substitution can trigger once every 5s.

entries.name: Romantic Conquest
entries.text: **Basic Attack**, **Dodge**, **Assist**, **Special Attack**, and **Chain Attack** Lv. +2

entries.name: Overlord's Will
entries.text:
**EX Special Attack: Overpowered Shield Bash** and **Assist Follow-Up: Aiding Blade** are guaranteed to trigger a critical hit.
The skill's DMG is increased by 50% and deals additional 50% DMG to the primary target.
When Caesar uses **EX Special Attack: Overpowered Shield Bash** or **Assist Follow-Up: Aiding Blade**, her CRIT Rate is increased by 30% and her CRIT DMG is increased by 60% for 15s.
